why: D3 v4 entity probe: per candidate entity (36 countries, 23 sports, 40 animals, 21 body parts), the cue -> entity, entity -> fact and cue -> fact prompts without context; entities right on all three enter pointer_v4
format: chat template, thinking off, 'Answer:' prefilled; the question and the instruction alone (no context)
judge: pointer_v1's: the first digit or number word (or the domain's entity) in the first non-empty line of 8 greedy tokens
rule: an entity enters pointer_v4 iff its cue -> entity, entity -> fact and cue -> fact prompts are all right; a domain is usable iff >= 16 entities pass; the first 3 usable domains in the order ['countries', 'sports', 'animals', 'body'] are used
